# Maalik-e-Makaan

> Tenant and property management for Pakistani landlords, in English and Urdu. A Flutter app (Android, iOS, web) on a Supabase backend (PostgreSQL 17 with row-level security, an exact-money ledger, pg_cron jobs, Deno Edge Functions), a pure-Dart domain library, a design system, a bilingual Astro website, and TLA+, Lean 4, Z3 and Bend models of the concurrent and money code. MIT licence.

Money is whole paisa in integers (numeric(14,2) in SQL); financial rows are voided, never deleted; authorisation lives in Postgres; locks are taken in the order account, portfolio, lease, other rows. Every check is a `make` target that CI also runs. This file indexes the repository's documentation; the website publishes its own llms.txt for its public content.
